verdict.rationale: Rate limits are a fair question for GitHub Projects, which exposes a GraphQL API for automation (github-docs-9, github-docs-15), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API rate limits, point budgets, or concurrency caps. API existence and token-type docs are adjacent and do not cover limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
